_readme: Copy this file to private-biodata/approval/data-processing-approval.json, fill it in ONLY after management has approved in writing, and set confirmed to true. It contains no personal data. The real migration (npm run db:migrate -- --apply) refuses to run without it.
approvedBy: Name and position of the person who approved (management / person responsible for PDPA)
region: Region of the Supabase project that was approved, e.g. Tokyo or Singapore
reference: Where the written approval is kept, e.g. signed memo dated ..., file name or folder
